newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek up on 1996 earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Partek up on 1996 earnings report.

text.p: Shares in Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment maker Partek Oy Ab rose sharply in modest trade on Thursday after the group reported 1996 earnings down but better than expected, brokers said.
At 1210/1010 GMT Partek traded at 74.90 markka, up 2.40 or more than three percent, in four million markka trade.
Brokers said the share still had upside, but did not foresee major gains.
"I don't think it will go much higher. I think it will trade between 73.00 and 77.00 in the near term," one broker said. --Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 235
